conclusions: Trade window = window id 3, object ROOT+0x3399C, vtable 0x47663C, ctor 0x4159D0 registered at 0x4277B0-0x4277C2 (frame 0x41A=1050), painted via render-dispatch thunk 0x4281A8 -> 0x415B10.
The panel art is GameInter.wil frame 1050 (512x512 @ offset (7,-44)); the UI hit rect is only 484x330, so the art overflows the rect.

Runtime-drawn: frame 1050 itself, grid item icons (0x466800/[0x476248]/0x4542F0 src [0x8AB7BC]), hovered-cell highlight (SetRect + fill). Everything else (close/accept/cancel button art, gold box, name/hp text, pane dividers, cell backgrounds) is baked into frame 1050.

Close/accept/cancel buttons are invisible hit-zones: close (frames 161/162 @ (532,350)), accept (1061/1062 @ (185,332)), cancel (1064/1065 @ (225,332)). Cancel's frames 1064/1065 DO NOT EXIST in GameInter.wil (count 1103; header returns None) - by design. Button render 0x417640 has ZERO direct xrefs and the trade paint has no [vtable+4] control loop, so buttons are never drawn.

The two gauges (+0x13648/+0x13694, frame 1070 = 16x360 divider art, ctor 0x417960) are the pane split-divider drag handles: mouse 0x416E70 writes the split widths [+0x54]/[+0x58] from gauge float weights; they are never blitted.

Item grid: 24 slot records at +0x5B8 (stride 0xC2C), item-id words at +0x298 (400 words, empty 0xFFFF), 36px cells 5x6 per pane; clicks route via 0x416830/0x416950 to slot actions (0x416C20/0x416D60/0x416DC0) and msgs 0x402/0x403 through 0x451AA0/0x451AD0 to runtime trade state 0x8AB828.

Gold box click (rect (34,270)..(156,304)) opens msgbox 0x405 '你要给对方多少金币?' (0x418030); accept click sends msg 0x406 via 0x451B30(0x8AB828) and sets finalize flag [+0x13644]=1, after which the window ignores clicks (0x416FB4).

Click handling returns: consumed (1) -> dispatcher calls 0x42ADB0(esi,3) (re-activate window 3); not consumed (0) -> dispatcher continues. The close button does NOT close the window itself (sound only); the window is closed by the runtime hide path (vtable+8 -> 0x423CF0 -> field-init reset).
Distinct from store: store = id 2 / +0x33188 / 0x44D310 / 0x44E260 with control render loops; trade = id 3 / +0x3399C / 0x4159D0 / 0x415B10 with zero control rendering.
